sentences.text:
By way of present civil writ petition filed under Article 226/227 of the Constitution of India, prayer
has been made for issuance of a writ in the nature of mandamus to to issue specific directions to
respondent Nos.1 to 3 to release the full and final payment of compensation amount against
acquisition of her land situated in the revenue estate of Village Jaswal Lahri, Tehsil and District
Pathankot which was acquired for th the e public purpose of providing connectivity to Delhi
Delhi-Ludhiana-Amritsar-Katra Katra express highway in terms of notification dated 01.10.2021
issued under Section 3A of Nhai Act, 1956.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the amount of compensation as determined vide award dated 09.
09.11.2022 .2022 passed by respondent No.3 along with interest (vide cheque dated 02.02.2026 bearing No.893092 amounting to Rs.1,96,670/ Rs.1,96,670/-)) stands released.

I agree to specified portions of this document points out that with respect to pipeline passing through the land of petitioner-landowner, no assessment was made by respondent No.3, however, aggrieved thereof, he has already invoked arbitration which is pending before the learned Divisional Commissioner, Jalandhar.
In view of the aforesaid, once the principal amount along with interest already stands released in Sudarshan Kaur vs Union Of India And Others on 3 February, 2026
